name: sapui5-code-assist
description: SAPUI5 autocomplete, hover documentation, and code assistance for XML views, fragments, and JavaScript.

sapui5Autocomplete.version.description: SAPUI5 data version used for completion and hover information.

sapui5Autocomplete.dataPath.description: Base directory for SAPUI5 JSON data. Relative paths are resolved from the extension root.

sapui5Autocomplete.projectDetection.description: Controls when SAPUI5 providers are active. 'auto' detects SAPUI5 projects/files, 'always' enables all supported files, and 'disabled' turns the providers off.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/dataLoader.js && node --check src/projectDetector.js && node --check src/xmlCompletionProvider.js && node --check src/jsSymbolCompletionProvider.js && node scripts/validate-data.js
